data.why: The app is a single self-contained index.html that loads built-in simulated apoptosis and cell-cycle FCS data automatically on page load; no files need to be uploaded or seeded.

goals: Load simulated apoptosis flow cytometry data and gate for live, early apoptotic, late apoptotic, and necrotic populations using sequential FSC/SSC debris exclusion, singlet gating, and Annexin V/7-AAD quadrant gating
Propagate ('anchor') a gate set from a representative control sample across all replicate samples in an experiment, then override the gate on individual samples where needed
Run cell-cycle analysis by gating FSC-A x SSC-A then PI-width x PI-area to exclude doublets, and assign Sub-G1/G1/S/G2M/>4N fractions from a PI-A DNA content histogram

Compare population percentages across experimental groups (e.g. Control vs Drug A vs Drug B vs Drug A+B) with a Prism-style bar plot showing mean +/- SD/SEM, replicate points, and Welch's t-test significance brackets
Overlay histograms across conditions with offset stacking or per-condition color to visualize shifts in DNA content or marker intensity
Export publication-ready figures (PNG at 300/600/1200 dpi, editable SVG) and save/reload gate-template JSON files and statistics/plot CSVs for reproducibility

review.summary: The tree describes what Anchorgating is for (gating replicated apoptosis or cell-cycle experiments once on an anchor, then producing statistics and journal-sized figures), its labels are clean, and the screens I checked mostly match. Before filing, it needs the missing axis-transform, FCS-intake and template-reload tasks, a split of the combined export feature, and corrected evidence for screens/008.webp.
